summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall flow downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...), extracts an executable, chmods it to 0o755, hardlinks it into bin/.onecode, and the shipped launcher spawns it. The fetch is performed with rejectUnauthorized:false (TLS certificate verification explicitly disabled) and no hash or signature check is applied to the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to a publisher-owned domain for the @onescience scope, and it is neither a versioned release artifact from a known vendor CDN nor a pinned, verifiable payload. Installing the package causes arbitrary code from whoever controls that IP — or any on-path attacker able to intercept the unverified TLS connection — to run on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
